name: Upper Thomson
summary: Café spine, reservoir weekends, and a north-central lifestyle with growing MRT access.
body: Upper Thomson has matured into a genuine living neighbourhood — brunch strips, condo clusters, and MacRitchie / Lower Peirce weekends. The Thomson-East Coast Line improved connectivity; it still feels less transient than River Valley. Good for families and couples who want green access without full east-coast commitment.
watchOuts: Still some commute friction to CBD
housingMix: Newer and mid-age condos; landed toward the north.
commuteNotes: Thomson-East Coast Line (Upper Thomson, Bright Hill).
